name: file-operations
when_to_use: When files need to be created, modified, overwritten, or removed. Protected paths and TCB invariants are strictly respected.
steps: Verify that the target path is not protected or part of the TCB boundary (safety.py, tool_dispatch.py, loop.py, redactor.py, updater/, config, brain).
For destructive operations (delete, overwrite): request explicit user confirmation prior to execution.
For overwrite operations: ensure file content is inspected before applying changes.
Verify that the file was written accurately by reading it back post-operation.
